title: Writing-RL: Advancing Long-form Writing via Adaptive Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Xuanyu Lei, Chenliang Li, Yuning Wu, Kaiming Liu, Weizhou Shen, Peng Li, Ming Yan, Fei Huang, Ya-Qin Zhang, Yang Liu
paper_type_zh: 面向长篇写作的自适应课程强化学习研究
best_for_zh: 为开放式生成设计数据选择和自适应参考调度的读者。
one_line: Writing-RL selects long-form writing instructions by policy-to-reference quality margin and promotes the reference after each policy win.
该工作按策略与参考写作质量差选择长文指令，并在策略获胜后逐步提升参考答案难度。
why: It makes the training record and reward target progressively harder instead of holding a static preference target throughout RL.
inclusion_reason: It changes which writing instructions and reference responses are consumed by RL, then changes the reference difficulty as the policy improves.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-form writing has no single ground-truth answer, so the verifiable rewards that work for mathematics and code cannot simply be reused. Supervised writer models can imitate long responses, but their improvement is constrained by the quality ceiling of the collected demonstrations and can saturate as more similar examples are added.

The paper asks how reinforcement learning can improve open-ended writing when a static reward model and a fixed reference answer give weak or stale learning signals. Its answer is to make the training set and the comparison target responsive to the current policy: retain instructions on which stronger systems reveal a meaningful gap, then raise the reference difficulty only after the policy has caught up.

长篇写作不存在唯一的标准答案，因此在数学和代码中有效的可验证奖励无法直接复用。监督训练得到的写作模型能够模仿长文本，但其提升受已收集示范答案质量上限的约束；当持续加入相似样本时，性能还可能逐渐饱和。

论文要回答的是：当静态奖励模型和固定参考答案只能提供微弱或过时的学习信号时，如何用强化学习提升开放式写作。它的回答是让训练集与比较目标随当前策略而变化：保留那些更强系统能暴露显著差距的指令，并且只在策略追上当前参考答案后才提高参考答案的难度。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Writing-RL treats a useful writing example as a moving relation between a policy and a ladder of candidate references, rather than as a permanently labeled prompt. For each instruction, the relevant quantity is learning potential: the score of the best available candidate minus the initial policy score. A large positive margin means that the prompt has a credible improvement target; prompts where every candidate is poor are not useful targets.

The framework then turns that relation into an adaptive curriculum. Pairwise comparison against a current reference supplies a simple win, tie, or loss reward, while a prompt-specific pointer begins at the weakest available reference and advances after a win. The policy therefore practices against an attainable target before it is asked to match a stronger one, instead of optimizing against a single static teacher throughout training.

Writing-RL 将有用的写作样本视为策略与一组分层候选参考答案之间不断变化的关系，而不是一个被永久标注的提示。对每条指令，关键量是学习潜力：可用候选答案中的最高得分减去初始策略得分。较大的正差距意味着该提示提供了可信的提升目标；若所有候选答案质量都很差，这类提示就不是有价值的训练目标。

随后，该框架把这种关系转化为自适应课程。当前参考答案上的成对比较提供简单的胜、平或负奖励；同时，每条提示专属的指针从最弱的可用参考答案开始，并在策略获胜后向前推进。因此，策略会先面对能够达到的目标，再被要求匹配更强的答案，而不是在整个训练过程中始终针对同一个静态教师进行优化。

title: Method
方法
html:
For every instruction from LongWriter or WritingBench, the initial policy, Qwen-Plus, GPT-4o, Claude-3.7, and DeepSeek-R1 produce candidate writings. A fine-tuned long-form judge gives pointwise scores. The method removes an instruction if all candidates score poorly, computes the best-candidate-minus-policy margin for the remainder, and selects the top 1,500 instructions from each source. Candidate responses are ordered by score to form a reference ladder for each retained instruction.

During PPO or GRPO training, Qwen-Plus compares a newly sampled policy response with the reference at that instruction's current pointer and returns one for a win, one half for a tie, and zero for a loss. The policy response is placed second in the comparison to make winning harder and to avoid doubled calls from swapping order. A win advances only that instruction's pointer to its next stronger reference, so difficulty is updated asynchronously rather than globally by epoch.

对于来自 LongWriter 或 WritingBench 的每条指令，初始策略、Qwen-Plus、GPT-4o、Claude-3.7 和 DeepSeek-R1 都会生成候选文章。一个微调过的长文评审器给出逐项分数。该方法先删除所有候选答案都得分很低的指令，再为其余指令计算最高候选分数减去策略分数的差距，并从每个来源选取前 1,500 条指令。候选回答再按得分排序，为每条保留指令构成一架参考答案阶梯。

在 PPO 或 GRPO 训练中，Qwen-Plus 将新采样的策略回答与该指令当前指针所指的参考答案进行比较：胜利记为一，平局记为二分之一，失败记为零。策略回答被放在比较中的第二个位置，以提高获胜难度，并避免交换顺序带来的双倍调用。一次胜利只会将该指令的指针推进到下一个更强的参考答案，因此难度不是按训练轮次全局更新，而是异步地逐题更新。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On Qwen2.5-7B-WritingBench-SFT, PPO reaches an average of 84.49 across WritingBench, Creative-Writing-Bench, and LongBench-Write, compared with 82.17 for the 12K-example supervised baseline; GRPO reaches 84.51. On the Llama3.1-8B writer, PPO reaches 87.29 versus 84.04 for the supervised baseline. A 14B Qwen writer reaches 88.53 under the reported RL setup. The study averages three runs and evaluates more than one writing benchmark.

Its ablations connect these gains to the proposed training decisions. Margin-aware selection raises the selected set's estimated learning potential to 9.16 and yields a WritingBench score of 86.98, above difficulty-only selection at 86.29 and unselected data at 85.91. Pairwise reward reaches 86.98 versus 84.50 for pointwise reward. Dynamic reference scheduling produces an 84.49 average, above static scheduling at 83.83, and the trained models also improve long-input reasoning averages on LongBench v2.

在 Qwen2.5-7B-WritingBench-SFT 上，PPO 在 WritingBench、Creative-Writing-Bench 和 LongBench-Write 三项上的平均分达到 84.49，而使用 12K 样本的监督基线为 82.17；GRPO 达到 84.51。在 Llama3.1-8B 写作模型上，PPO 达到 87.29，而监督基线为 84.04。14B 的 Qwen 写作模型在文中报告的强化学习设置下达到 88.53。研究对三次运行取平均，并在不止一个写作基准上进行评测。

消融实验将这些提升与提出的训练决策关联起来。基于差距的选择将入选集合的估计学习潜力提高到 9.16，并得到 86.98 的 WritingBench 分数，高于仅按难度选择的 86.29 和未选择数据的 85.91。成对奖励达到 86.98，而逐项奖励为 84.50。动态参考调度的平均分为 84.49，高于静态调度的 83.83；训练后的模型在 LongBench v2 上的长输入推理平均表现也有所提升。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is not merely using an LLM judge for open-ended writing. The paper defines data value relative to the learner by comparing the learner's initial writing with a pool of stronger candidate writings, then uses that margin to decide which prompts enter RL. This makes selection target a demonstrated opportunity for improvement rather than broad topical coverage, output length, or an absolute quality threshold alone.

It also makes the comparison target stateful at the individual-prompt level. Reference answers are not a fixed collection of preferred completions: they become a ladder that a policy climbs after observable wins. Combining margin selection, a deliberately asymmetric pairwise comparison, and asynchronous reference promotion gives a concrete way to turn heterogeneous, scored writing candidates into a curriculum without claiming that a single answer is objectively correct.

其独特贡献并不只是把大语言模型评审器用于开放式写作。论文通过比较学习者的初始写作与一组更强候选文章，将数据价值定义为相对学习者而言的量，并据此差距决定哪些提示进入强化学习。这样，选择目标变成了已被展示出来的提升机会，而不是只依赖宽泛的主题覆盖、输出长度或绝对质量阈值。

它还让比较目标在单条提示层面具有状态。参考答案不是一组固定的偏好完成文本，而是一架在策略出现可观察胜利后逐级攀登的阶梯。将差距选择、刻意不对称的成对比较以及异步参考推进结合起来，给出了把异质、已评分的写作候选答案转化为课程的一种具体方式，同时并不声称存在唯一客观正确的答案。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method relies on a fine-tuned judge for selection and Qwen-Plus for recurrent pairwise rewards, so judge preferences, positional bias, API availability, and cost can affect the resulting curriculum. The reported gains are strongest at 7B, 8B, and 14B writer scales and start from supervised writer models; the authors explicitly leave larger-scale experiments and the question of whether RL alone can elicit the effect from a base model for future work. The paper also does not supply a dedicated contamination analysis for its source corpora and evaluations.
该方法依赖一个微调评审器进行选择，并依赖 Qwen-Plus 反复给出成对奖励，因此评审器偏好、位置偏差、接口可用性和成本都可能影响最终课程。报告中的提升主要出现在 7B、8B 和 14B 写作模型规模，且训练从监督写作模型开始；作者明确将更大规模实验，以及仅靠强化学习能否从基础模型诱发这一效果的问题留给后续研究。论文也没有针对其来源语料和评测给出专门的数据污染分析。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This is useful when a team has several candidate responses per open-ended prompt but cannot justify a universal gold answer. It offers a reproducible decision rule for deciding which prompts deserve RL budget, how to convert scored candidates into a comparator, and when to make a particular example harder. It is particularly relevant to long-form writing, but the underlying pattern can also inform other subjective generation tasks if the candidate pool, judge reliability, and licensing conditions are independently audited.
当团队为同一开放式提示拥有多个候选回答，却无法证明存在一个普适的金标准答案时，这项工作很有用。它提供了可复现的决策规则，用于决定哪些提示值得消耗强化学习预算、如何把已评分的候选答案变成比较对象，以及何时应当提高某一具体样本的难度。它尤其适合长篇写作，但若候选池、评审器可靠性和许可条件都经过独立审计，底层模式也可为其他主观生成任务提供参考。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 3 and 4 together: the important object is the per-instruction state composed of a margin-selected prompt, an ordered reference ladder, and a moving pointer, not simply the PPO or GRPO optimizer. Then inspect Tables 3–5, which separate selection, reward form, and scheduling. Before adopting the recipe, check whether the same judge can rank candidate texts consistently, whether candidate-generation models are permitted for the intended data, and whether an apparent win against the judge reflects the writing quality a deployment actually needs.
应将第 3 节和第 4 节结合阅读：重要对象是由按差距选出的提示、排序后的参考答案阶梯和移动指针构成的逐指令状态，而不只是 PPO 或 GRPO 优化器。接着查看表 3 至表 5，它们分别拆分了选择、奖励形式和调度的作用。在采用该方案之前，应检查同一个评审器能否稳定地排序候选文本、候选生成模型是否被允许用于目标数据，以及在评审器面前看似获胜是否真正反映部署场景所需的写作质量。
